groups.description: Size, complexity and comment noise for any code file.
React/Solid components in TSX: a file holds the max over its components and names it.
Git history per file in the selected window (90 days by default). On whenever the folder is a Git repo.
Lint and type-check results: the project's own tsc and eslint when it has them, otherwise srcly's bundled ruff and TS rules. No setup.
Render-path evidence from the TypeScript checker, after `srcly report --dataflow`: dead `??` guards, repeated forks and the worst value path in each TS/TSX file.
Counts that describe code without saying it needs work: shown and colorable, never ranked.

metrics.label: Complexity (max)
metrics.description: Cyclomatic complexity: exact for a function; for a file or folder, its most complex function, which it names.

metrics.label: Cognitive complexity (max)
metrics.description: How hard a function is to follow (Sonar's cognitive complexity): each if, loop, catch or ternary costs 1 plus its nesting, and each run of && or || costs 1, so a flat chain of checks stays low. A file or folder holds its worst function, which it names.

metrics.label: Complexity (avg)
metrics.description: Mean cyclomatic complexity per function; folders weight by function count.

metrics.label: LOC
metrics.description: Lines of code, excluding comments and blanks where the analyzer can tell.

metrics.label: Size
metrics.description: File size in bytes.

metrics.label: Comment Noise
metrics.description: Over-commenting flags: functions with more comment lines than code lines (10+ code lines), docblocks over 1.5x their body (8+ lines), and 3+ line runs of commented-out code.

metrics.label: Nesting
metrics.description: Deepest control-flow nesting.

metrics.label: Params
metrics.description: Function parameters; a file sums its functions, so rank the Functions cohort for arity.

metrics.label: Function Length (avg)
metrics.description: Mean function length in LOC; folders weight by function count. Detail: the M7 pilot's queues were tests, markup and one-function files.

metrics.label: Component LOC
metrics.description: Lines in one React/Solid component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: Hooks
metrics.description: Hooks (`use*`) and Solid primitives (`create*`) in one component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: Effects
metrics.description: `useEffect`/`useLayoutEffect`/`createEffect` calls in one component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: JSX Depth
metrics.description: Deepest JSX nesting inside one component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: Props
metrics.description: Declared props of one component (props type members or destructured names). A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: Inline Handlers
metrics.description: Inline `on*={() => ...}` handlers in one component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: JSX Conditionals
metrics.description: JSX conditionals (`?:`, `&&`, `<Show>`, `<Match>`) in one component. A file or folder holds the max over its components and names it.

metrics.label: any Usage
metrics.description: Explicit `any` types.

metrics.label: TS Ignores
metrics.description: `@ts-ignore` / `@ts-expect-error` / `@ts-nocheck` directives.

metrics.label: Markdown Data URLs
metrics.description: Inline `data:` URLs (embedded images) in Markdown.

metrics.label: Commits
metrics.description: Non-merge commits that touched the file in the activity window, following renames. Frequent change in complex code is where refactoring pays off.

metrics.label: Churn
metrics.description: Lines added plus removed by those commits. Kept apart from commit count: one bulk rewrite churns a lot in a single commit.

metrics.label: Findings
metrics.description: Everything the checkers reported for the file: the project's tsc and eslint, or srcly's ruff and TS rules. The code viewer lists each one with its rule and tool.

metrics.label: Errors
metrics.description: Findings the checker calls errors: type errors, eslint errors, syntax errors and undefined names. Warnings aren't counted.

metrics.label: Impossible Defenses
metrics.description: `??` and `?.` whose guarded value the TypeScript types say is never null or undefined, so the fallback never runs. Only a type checker can prove this.

metrics.label: Repeated Forks
metrics.description: Components that test the same discriminant at several sibling branch sites (ternaries, `&&`, Solid `<Show>` and `<Match>`): each wants one sub-component per branch.

metrics.label: Prop Relay
metrics.description: The most component boundaries a value crosses on its way to one of the file's render sinks.

metrics.label: Shape Changes
metrics.description: The most representation-only steps (alias, object pack, spread) on one of the file's render paths.

metrics.label: Path Depth
metrics.description: The most steps from a source (prop, signal, local) to one of the file's JSX sinks.

metrics.label: Value Fan-Out
metrics.description: The most render sinks that one of the file's sink sources also feeds. Wide reach is a fact, not a fault.

metrics.label: TODOs
metrics.description: TODO/FIXME-style comments.

metrics.label: Narrated Code
metrics.description: Comment noise part: functions (or a whole file) with more comment lines than code lines and 10+ code lines.

metrics.label: Oversized Docblocks
metrics.description: Comment noise part: docblocks or docstrings of 8+ lines that are over 1.5x their function's code lines.

metrics.label: Commented-out Code
metrics.description: Comment noise part: runs of 3+ line comments that parse as code.

metrics.label: Comment Lines
metrics.description: Comment lines.

metrics.label: Functions
metrics.description: Executable functions at any depth (methods, nested functions, arrows).

metrics.label: Classes
metrics.description: Class declarations.

metrics.label: TS Imports
metrics.description: Distinct import sources.

metrics.label: Types/Interfaces
metrics.description: Type and interface declarations.

metrics.label: Exports
metrics.description: Export declarations.

metrics.label: Python Imports
metrics.description: Import statements.

metrics.label: Files
metrics.description: Files a node represents.

presets.label: Activity
presets.description: Complex files that keep changing are where a refactor pays off first.

quadrants.name: Hot mess
quadrants.text: Complex and changing often: refactor first.

quadrants.name: Sleeping giant
quadrants.text: Complex but rarely touched: leave it until it wakes.

quadrants.name: Busy, fine
quadrants.text: Changes often and stays simple.

quadrants.name: Quiet
quadrants.text: Simple and stable.

presets.label: Blast radius
presets.description: Complex files that many others import break the most when they change.

quadrants.name: Load-bearing tangle
quadrants.text: Complex and widely imported: change with tests.

quadrants.name: Isolated mess
quadrants.text: Complex, few importers: safe to rework.

quadrants.name: Hub
quadrants.text: Widely imported and simple: keep it that way.

quadrants.name: Leaf
quadrants.text: Simple, few importers.

presets.label: Component weight
presets.description: React/Solid components that are long, hook-heavy, or both.

quadrants.name: God component
quadrants.text: Long and hook-heavy: split state from markup.

quadrants.name: Long markup
quadrants.text: Long with few hooks: extract subcomponents.

quadrants.name: Hook soup
quadrants.text: Short but hook-heavy: pull logic into a custom hook.

quadrants.name: Lean
quadrants.text: Short with few hooks.

presets.label: Comment noise
presets.description: Whether comments sit on the complex code that needs them.

quadrants.name: Narrated complexity
quadrants.text: Complex, with as many comment lines as code: check the comments still match it.

quadrants.name: Narrated trivia
quadrants.text: Simple code with as many comment lines as code: trim the comments.

quadrants.name: Complex code
quadrants.text: Complex, with more code than comments: simplify before explaining.

quadrants.name: Clean
quadrants.text: Simple, with more code than comments.

presets.label: Findings
presets.description: Whether the lint and type checkers flag the complex files or the simple ones.

quadrants.name: Flagged tangle
quadrants.text: Complex and flagged by the checkers: fix the findings before refactoring.

quadrants.name: Clean but complex
quadrants.text: Complex with quiet checkers: a refactor starts from solid ground.

quadrants.name: Quick cleanup
quadrants.text: Simple code with findings: cheap fixes.

quadrants.name: Clean
quadrants.text: Simple and clean.
